Layout of struct mtrr_var_range and mtrr_state and numeric values of type, valid, capability and enable constants.

Synchronization protecting cache map insertion, removal, clearing and rebuild paths.
Semantics of stop machine rendezvous, cpuhotplug states, and cache control flags memory_caching_control and delayed init.

findings.text: Provides a translation from a small numeric cache type identifier to a human readable label, returning a placeholder when the identifier is outside the known table.
Boot time collector that snapshots variable and fixed memory type state plus default type and enable flags, records that the snapshot is valid, and reports whether the main enable is set.
Predicate that reports whether the current processor forces memory above four gigabytes to writeback through a vendor specific system configuration setting.
Boot processor restore hook that reestablishes caching control when the platform flag indicates such control is present.
Late initialization hook that completes delayed application processor cache rendezvous exactly once when caching control and the delayed flag are both active.
Reports whether a trusted boot context is currently active.
Per processor adjustment of virtualization and enclave capability flags based on the feature control register, build options, and trusted boot mode.

Vendor dispatch during memory type setup that selects an alternate range interface for specific legacy families when the corresponding emulation feature is advertised, otherwise leaving the default in place.

Hotplug callbacks track online application processors in a dedicated mask and trigger a coordinated cache rendezvous on arrival, plus a boot time registration that allocates the mask and installs the callbacks.

Ordered memory map insertion ignores empty or inverted intervals, coalesces with adjacent non fixed neighbours of equal type by extending one neighbour or fusing two, otherwise shifts later entries to make room.

Removal compacts the ordered map by shifting successors down and decrementing the count, while range clearing either deletes a fully covered entry, trims a leading or trailing overlap, or splits an interior overlap and reports whether the original start was preserved.

Variable map construction first pins a writeback entry above four gigabytes when a top of memory extension is present, then appends each enabled variable range; enable is determined by a valid bit in the mask, with base aligned to page granularity and size derived from the masked complement after forcing reserved high bits.
Upper bound for the in memory cache map equals the fixed entry count plus twice the variable register count plus one extra slot when the top of memory extension is active.

Snapshot covers capability fixed support indication, all variable registers, fixed ranges when supported, default type and enable flags, and vendor top of memory when the special default applies; validity is latched and the main enable status is returned, with optional diagnostic logging.

Variable collection reads a base and mask register pair per index into low and high halves, while fixed collection first performs a vendor DRAM mode check then reads one wide region plus two medium regions plus eight narrow regions into consecutive slots.

Diagnostic dump of fixed ranges walks groups of eight entries and merges contiguous entries of identical type into single intervals before printing, flushing any pending interval at group boundaries and at the end.
Initialization marks every variable slot usage count as singly referenced.
Alternate header provides a no operation vendor selection, leaving any default interface unchanged.

Centaur family initialization enables on chip crypto and random hardware when firmware reports presence without enable, records extended feature flags, adjusts cache alignment and string behaviour for newer models, advertises timestamp behaviours by family and power capability, detects performance monitoring from version and counter fields, and on thirty two bit builds tunes control bits and cache size reporting per model.
Cache size normalization shifts down reported values for two specific model numbers and corrects an off by one overreport on a single stepping of another model.

When the control register is unreadable both virtualization and enclave capabilities are withdrawn; when unlocked the register is rewritten from a locked baseline with enables gated by build options and trusted boot mode, then capabilities are pruned if firmware left the corresponding enables clear, including handling that can retain enclave virtualization while dropping driver use when launch control is locked.

Virtualization capability discovery reads primary controls unconditionally plus optional secondary, tertiary, pin, function, and combined paging identifier registers, merges pin plus identifier plus function bits into a miscellaneous word with manual placement of scattered paging properties, synthesizes aggregate priority and virtual interrupt features from combinations, and mirrors selected properties into architectural feature flags for user visible reporting.

Special default applies only to two vendor identifiers with family fifteen or higher where a safe system configuration read succeeds and both top memory enable and force writeback indications are set.
Processor driver record binds a vendor string and identifier plus early and normal initialization hooks and a vendor number, with an additional legacy cache size hook on thirty two bit builds.

Per processor x86 description storage plus a user address limit, a secondary hardware capability word, and topology maxima for threads per core, dies per package, logical packages, nodes per package, and cores per package, the latter group immutable after initialization with unity defaults.

Diagnostic accumulator has empty and pending states; empty starts a new interval, pending extends on contiguous equal type and otherwise flushes the old interval and starts a new one, with explicit flush returning to empty.

Feature control handling progresses from probe to locked decision to virtualization validation to enclave validation, where the locked decision either preserves firmware state or installs a fresh locked value, and each validation stage may clear its capability without affecting earlier stages.

Application processor online path must not acquire the memory type mutex because it runs in boot or resume context where holding it would deadlock; quiescence relies on absence of updates during early resume and on the hotplug lock being held by update paths during hot add.

If variable insertions exceed the precomputed map capacity the implementation emits a warning and truncates the map back to its fixed prefix, silently discarding previously inserted variable coverage.

Crypto presence is bit six and crypto enabled status is bit seven with activation in bit twenty eight of its control register; random presence is bit two and random enabled status is bit three with activation in bit six of its control register.

Diagnostic fixed coverage spans addresses zero to one megabyte in three tiers with sixty four kilobyte, sixteen kilobyte and four kilobyte granularities, and the AMD extension region starts at four gigabytes.
Virtualization feature encoding uses only the low five bits of the feature number to select a bit within a thirty two bit word.
Early boot page table build is configured for five level paging.
Known attribute table holds seven entries indexed zero through six.
Thirty two bit feature control tuning uses fixed bit positions for cache, error, power and instruction behaviours collected in a single enumeration.
